headline: Frontline Casualties Surge as Mooring County Remains Hot
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the heaviest fighting remains centred on Mooring County, where seven base changes were recorded in the past two hours and casualties continue at roughly 660 Colonial and 630 Warden per hour, both trending downward. Callums Cape still registers the war’s highest loss rates — about 970 Colonial and 1,150 Warden per hour — but the pace has shifted from accelerating to cooling and only two base moves occurred in the last six hours. Linn Mercy’s casualty flow has collapsed to near‑zero in the most recent hour, yet thirteen base events in the past six hours keep the sector contested. Weathered Expanse shows a similar decline to roughly 260 Colonial and 250 Warden per hour, with ten base changes in the last six hours. Marban Hollow has gone quiet, while Stlican Shelf is the sole front where losses are rising again, Colonial and Warden rates accelerating to 59 and 109 per hour alongside three recent flips. Elsewhere the line is largely static.
